The '''''Valkryie''''' was a [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] that was flown by [[Air Marshal]] [[Cargeloch]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Ace/Legends|ace]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who was stationed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]].<ref name="CatCW" />
